about: A reviewer's answer and the verdict read from it: the first line that starts (after spaces or tabs) with the whole word VERIFIED or REJECTED (not followed by a letter, a digit, `_` or `/`), optionally after `NARROW:`. `text` is the answer from that line on, its leading spaces dropped; `line` is the first line of `text`. `verdict: null` means no verdict. The Harness reader (harness/lib/verdict.cjs), the worfy app's copy (src/shared/workflow/verdict.mjs) and the grader rejected-first of the eval case reviewer-verdict must agree on every case.
